# Vendor note: Orbit Payroll

- Service: payroll processing for 120 employees in France and Germany, payslips and
  social declarations included.
- Pricing: 6.50 EUR per payslip per month; year-end tax statements 4 EUR each; setup
  fee 1,800 EUR.
- Term: 36 months.
- Termination: 6 months notice before the end of the term; no exit before month 24
  except for repeated SLA breaches (3 in 12 months).
- SLA: payslips delivered 3 business days before pay date; penalties 5% of the monthly
  fee per late run.
- Risks: long lock-in; data migration out of Orbit is billed at 120 EUR per hour; German
  declarations handled by a partner company.
